title: La familia y los posesivos
summary: Family vocabulary and possessives — mi, tu, su, nuestro, vuestro.

blocks.title: La familia
blocks.body: Meet the core family words. Most follow the **-o/-a** pattern you already know: **el hermano / la hermana** (brother/sister), **el abuelo / la abuela** (grandfather/grandmother), **el hijo / la hija** (son/daughter), **el tío / la tía** (uncle/aunt — yes, the same word you know as 'mate/dude'). **Los padres** means 'parents', not just 'fathers'.
blocks.callout: Ojo: *tío/tía* means 'uncle/aunt' at home and 'mate/dude' at the bar — context tells you which.

blocks.title: Posesivos: mi, tu, su…
blocks.body: Possessives agree in **number** with the thing owned, not the owner: **mi hermano, mis hermanos** (my brother/brothers). **Nuestro** and **vuestro** also agree in **gender**: **nuestro padre, nuestra madre, vuestros hijos, vuestras hijas**. **Su/sus** covers his, her, your (formal), and their — context decides.
blocks.callout: **Vuestro** is Spain's plural-informal 'your' — it belongs to the *vosotros* family.

pairs.note: mi/tu/su only change for number; nuestro/vuestro change for gender too.

blocks.explain: *casa* is feminine singular, so it's *nuestra casa*. Nuestro/vuestro agree in gender **and** number with the noun.

blocks.hint: Possessives like mi/tu/su only change for number, not gender.
blocks.explain: *mis hermanas* — **mis** marks the plural; *hermana* already shows feminine with -a.

blocks.prompt: Listen and type what you hear.

blocks.scene: Lucía asks about your family over coffee.

lines.speaker: You
lines.nl: Sí, tengo una hermana y un hermano. ¿Y tú?
lines.en: Yes, I have a sister and a brother. And you?

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.nl: Yo tengo un hermano mayor. Vive con nuestros padres.
lines.en: I have an older brother. He lives with our parents.
lines.spotlight: nuestros padres — nuestro agrees in gender/number with padres.

lines.speaker: Lucía
lines.nl: Mira, mi abuela vive en Madrid, cerca de mi barrio.
lines.en: Look, my grandmother lives in Madrid, close to my neighborhood.

blocks.prompt: Describe tu familia: ¿cuántos hermanos tienes? ¿Dónde viven tus padres o tus abuelos?
